subject: Discovery follow-up - VP/CTO intro & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@acmecorp.com>, Carlos Ruiz <carlos.ruiz@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2029-10-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Discovery follow-up - VP/CTO intro & next steps

Hi Elena (and Carlos),

Thanks again for the time today - really helpful to hear how AcmeCorp is thinking about embedding LLM features across product and platform. Quick recap of what we covered and proposed next steps so we stay aligned:

- Recap: primary use cases (search summarization, in-app assistance), target scale (100k active users/month), latency requirement (~200ms p95 for user-facing completion)
- Current blockers you mentioned: security/compliance evidence and an exec alignment on cost/SLA tradeoffs

Proposed next steps:
1) 30-min exec alignment (VP/CTO intro) - high level: business metrics, runway, success criteria - will include Vivek (VP Product) and me
2) 60-min technical deep dive/demo - will include Rishi (our SE) to walk architecture, integration patterns, and quantization/hosting options

Are you available for either of these slots?
- Exec alignment (30 min): Wed Oct 2 10:00-10:30 PT or Thu Oct 3 09:00-09:30 PT
- Technical deep dive (60 min): Thu Oct 3 11:00-12:00 PT or Fri Oct 4 09:00-10:00 PT

If those don't work, happy to propose a couple more times. I'll also attach a short agenda and our pricing overview so Carlos can get a sense of unit economics before the call. If there are other stakeholders we should loop in (security, infra), please let me know.

Thanks - looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0102

Attachments: exec-alignment-agenda.docx, redwood-pricing-overview.pdf

From: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@acmecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Carlos Ruiz <carlos.ruiz@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2029-10-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up - VP/CTO intro & next steps

Thanks Marissa - great recap.

Carlos (our CTO) and I think an executive alignment makes sense before the technical deep dive so Carlos has context on business priorities and cost implications. He prefers the executive intro to happen next week (week of Oct 7) rather than this week.

Would Tue Oct 8 at 1:00 PM PT work for your team for a 30-minute exec intro? If so, we'll follow with a 60-minute technical deep dive the following week. Please include whoever owns security/compliance on your side - our security lead (Ana Morales) will likely join the deep dive. Also can you share a SOC 2 summary and a one-pager on data handling ahead of the exec call?

Carlos - looping you in so you have context.

Thanks,
Elena
Head of Product, AcmeCorp
elena.gomez@acmecorp.com
